notes: Ran with network access: literature check strict (8 counted queries, coverage, scout, similarity, novelty, 2 verify). related_search.py refuses queries over 4 concept words (including the 5-word queries I first tried), and 'benchmarks' returned nothing for these datasets, so benchmark scouting was done by hand. The novelty script rated C2 'high' from a single level-2 match while the Domain Reviewer judged it medium given the cited KGist/ANOT; the skill does not say who prevails (I let the reviewer's judgment prevail and said so). The venue-label wording for ICLR (0,2,4,... vs 1,3,5,...) is ambiguous and flagged secondary; I reported both. Compound shell commands needed separate calls under this harness. SKILL.md asks reviewers to be independent but full mode is run sequentially in one context, so independence is weak. The DA/EIC rules for criterion 3 had no clean row for 'selection sentence names no split' (resolved as MAJOR per the 'not stated' row). Verifying baseline descriptions (ToG, DALK) needs the original abstracts; the skill's verify command returns titles only, so those items stayed marked [verify].
